metadata.title: Bio-Study Rules, 2017 (S.R.O. 697(I)/2018)
metadata.edition: Notified 5 June 2018, in force at once · rule 12(2) IMP safety report within fifteen days (no place limit), 12(3) SAEs immediately; amended by S.R.O. 685(I)/2023 (not read)
metadata.legal_basis: Rules under the DRAP Act 2012 and the Drugs Act 1976; the Gazette text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
